message.content:
Painting the entire Eiffel Tower would be a massive undertaking. Roughly speaking:

| Task | Approx. Time (per crew) |
|------|------------------------|
| Surface prep (cleaning, rust removal, priming) | 2–3 weeks |
| Applying primer coat | 1–2 weeks |
| First color coat | 1–2 weeks |
| Second color coat (if needed) | 1–2 weeks |
| Final protective clear coat | 1 week |
| **Total** | **~8–12 weeks** |

These estimates assume a single crew working full‑time under normal weather conditions. In practice, multiple crews could work simultaneously on different sections, potentially cutting the overall schedule down to 4–6 weeks. However, logistical constraints (access, safety, coordination with city authorities) and weather interruptions often extend the project to 3–4 months.

So, if you’re planning a painting project, expect somewhere between **2 and 4 months** from start to finish, depending on crew size, weather, and regulatory approvals.
